recommendation: Implement routine immunization assessment and administration
implementation_steps: Assess immunization status during routine care visits
Deliver patient education about vaccines and their importance
Provide reminders for upcoming or overdue vaccines
Administer vaccines during routine care visits under standing orders
Ensure follow-up for patients who miss appointments
evidence_summary: Nurse-led immunization assessment and administration interventions have demonstrated significant improvements in vaccination rates across multiple studies, particularly when implemented as part of routine care.
citation: A Review of the Key Factors to Improve Adult Immunization Coverage Rates
